summary: This quarter I focused on shortening the month-end close and getting the 2027 budget process started early. Close time dropped from 8 to 5 working days, and budget templates reached all six departments three weeks ahead of plan. Outside my objectives, I trained sales ops to self-serve their revenue dashboard.

achievements.result: Cut month-end close from 8 to 5 working days
achievements.situation: Close ran 8 days because 8 bank reconciliations were manual
achievements.action: I automated 6 of 8 reconciliations in Power Query and set a daily bank-file check

achievements.result: Bank reconciliation for 3 accounts now takes 2 hours instead of 1 day
achievements.action: Built a fuzzy-match reconciliation template reused by Accounting

achievements.result: Budget templates reached all 6 departments 3 weeks ahead of plan
achievements.situation: Last year templates went out late and 2 departments missed the deadline
achievements.action: I simplified the template to one tab per department and ran 6 walkthroughs

stakeholders.name: Treasury team
stakeholders.work: Bank file formats and reconciliation automation

extra_mile.title: Sales ops self-service
extra_mile.action: Trained 2 sales ops analysts on the revenue dashboard
extra_mile.result: Ad-hoc data requests to FP&A fell 40%

extra_mile.title: New-joiner onboarding
extra_mile.action: Wrote a 1-page close checklist for new analysts
extra_mile.result: Used by the team for every close since August

learning.development_area: Forecast accuracy: I am building a driver-based model with Sales for Q4.
